login.intro: Sign in with an administrator account.
login.notAdmin: This account is not an administrator.
auth.badCredentials: That username and password don't match. Check them and try again.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
auth.unreachable: The server didn't answer. Check it's running, then try again.
auth.reason.expired: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
auth.reason.notAdmin: This account is not an administrator.
auth.unreachableBody: Your session is kept. Check the server is running and your network is up, then try again.
shell.notifications.title: Notifications
shell.notifications.soon: Scan failures, offline libraries, new devices and updates will show up here in a later update of this redesign.
shell.theme.title: Appearance
soon.title: {{section}} is on its way
soon.phase: Planned for phase {{phase}} of the redesign.
soon.body.library: Browse every book by its cover, fix titles and authors in place, and see where each value came from. Your files are never touched.
soon.body.people: See every paired phone, tablet and browser, when each was last used, and sign one out.
soon.body.activity: See who is listening right now, listening hours over time, top books and how often playback needs transcoding.
soon.body.health: Find missing covers, unmatched books and duplicates, follow scans as they run, and know when a library goes offline.
soon.body.server: Network and TLS, transcoding, community metadata, backups, logs and updates, each in one clear place.
notFound.title: There's nothing here
notFound.body: The address may be mistyped, or the page moved. Your server and its books are fine.
home.error.title: The overview couldn't load
home.live.title: Listening now
home.recent.title: Recent listening
home.recent.empty: No one has played anything yet. Progress shows up here once people start listening.
home.server.title: Server
home.firstRun.title: Let's put your audiobooks on the shelf.
home.firstRun.body: Point AudioSilo at a folder. Your files stay exactly where they are: AudioSilo reads them, builds an index, and you can browse straight away while it works.
home.firstRun.add.title: Add a library
home.firstRun.scan.title: Let the first scan run
home.firstRun.scan.body: Covers fill in as books are found
home.firstRun.invite.title: Invite your household
home.firstRun.invite.body: A link or QR code pairs their phone
palette.title: Search and commands
palette.placeholder: Search pages, settings, or type a command
palette.action.rescanSub: Look for new, changed and moved books now
palette.action.signOutSub: End this session on this browser
palette.toast.rescanningSub: New and changed books appear as they're found. You can keep working.
palette.empty.title: Nothing matches “{{query}}”
palette.empty.body: Try a page like “Library”, a setting like “dark”, or an action like “rescan”.
errors.usernameTaken: Someone already has that name. Pick another one, for example with a last initial.
errors.nameTaken: That name is already in use. Pick another one.
errors.lastAdmin: This server needs at least one admin. Make someone else an admin first.
errors.adminNeedsPassword: Admins sign in with a password. Set one first.
errors.deleteSelf: You can't delete your own account. Ask another admin, or disable it instead.
errors.folderUnreadable: That folder doesn't exist on the server, or the server can't read it.
home.offline.title: {{name}} is offline. Nothing was deleted.
palette.action.inviteSub: Pair a phone, tablet or browser with a link or QR code
palette.action.addLibrarySub: Point AudioSilo at a folder of audiobooks
libraries.title: Libraries
libraries.description: Folders AudioSilo reads. Your files stay where they are.
libraries.empty.title: No libraries yet
libraries.empty.body: Add a folder of audiobooks. AudioSilo reads it and builds an index; nothing in the folder changes.
libraries.listLabel: Libraries, in the order players show them
libraries.orderHint: Players list libraries in this order. When the same book is in two libraries and both copies are equally good, the one in the higher library is used.
libraries.safety.title: Safety stop: nothing was deleted
libraries.safety.body_one: AudioSilo can't read {{root}}, so it kept its {{formatted}} book and everyone's progress. If it's a network share, mount it, then retry.
libraries.safety.body_other: AudioSilo can't read {{root}}, so it kept all {{formatted}} books and everyone's progress. If it's a network share, mount it, then retry.
libraries.dnd.instructions: To reorder, press space or enter to pick the library up, use the arrow keys to move it, then press space or enter to drop it. Press escape to cancel.
libraries.dnd.cancel: Cancelled. {{name}} is back where it was.
libraries.toast.addedBody: The first scan has started. Covers fill in as books are found.
libraries.toast.deletedBody: The folder and its files are untouched.
libraries.toast.scanStoppedBody: Its folder isn't reachable, so nothing was removed. Mount it, then retry.
libraries.form.addDescription: Pick a folder of audiobooks. AudioSilo only reads it; nothing in the folder changes.
libraries.form.editDescription: Rename the library or point it at another folder.
libraries.form.name: Name
libraries.form.folderHint: A folder on the server. Mount network shares (SMB, NFS) first. AudioSilo works out which folders are books by itself.
libraries.form.folderEditHint: Changing the folder rescans the library. Progress follows books that are found again.
libraries.form.folderRequired: Choose the folder that holds the audiobooks.
libraries.form.truncated: Only the first 1,000 folders are shown. Type the path if yours isn't listed.
libraries.delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
libraries.delete.description_one: Removes the library and its {{formatted}} book from AudioSilo, with everyone's progress, bookmarks and notes in it. The folder and its files are not touched.
libraries.delete.description_other: Removes the library and its {{formatted}} books from AudioSilo, with everyone's progress, bookmarks and notes in it. The folder and its files are not touched.
detect.title: Folder detection in {{name}}
detect.description: A folder that holds audio is one book. Correct any folder AudioSilo gets wrong; the library rescans after each change.
people.title: People
people.empty.title: Nobody here yet
people.empty.body: Invite your household. A link or QR code pairs their phone; no password needed.
invites.title: Invites
invites.description: One active invite per person. A code is shown only when it's created; rotate an invite to send a fresh one.
invites.empty.title: No invites yet
invites.empty.body: Invite someone and their link shows up here, with how many devices it has paired.
invites.noneActive: No active invites. Old and used-up ones are under All.
invites.revokeBody: The link and its QR code stop working at once. Devices already paired stay signed in.
invite.title: Invite someone
invite.description: They pair a phone, tablet or browser with a link or QR code. A password is optional.
invite.descriptionFor: Makes a fresh link and QR code for {{name}}'s next phone, tablet or browser.
invite.name: Their name
invite.nameHint: Shown in the player and in this console.
invite.access.label: What can they listen to?
invite.access.noneBody: They can pair now but won't see any books until you give them some
invite.accessFailed: The account was made, but its access wasn't
invite.replaces: {{name}} already has an active invite. A new one replaces it, so only the newest link works.
invite.readyDescription: Send the link, or let them scan the code with their phone's camera.
invite.card.headline: {{name}}, your audiobooks are waiting.
invite.card.body: Scan to open AudioSilo, or tap the link. No password needed.
invite.card.qr: QR code that pairs a device for {{name}}
invite.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select it and copy it yourself.
invite.codeOnce: This is the only time the code is shown. AudioSilo keeps only a fingerprint of it.
invite.fragment: The code rides in the link's fragment, never in server logs
user.access.admin: Admins always see everything. Access rules don't apply to them.
user.access.title: What {{name}} can listen to
user.access.description: Whole libraries and shares. New books in them appear automatically.
user.access.none: Nothing yet. {{name}} can sign in but won't see any books.
user.access.emptyShare: This share has no folders yet
user.access.changedBody: {{name}} sees the change the next time their app refreshes.
user.access.giveDescription: Pick a whole library or one of your shares.
user.access.nothingLeft: {{name}} already has every library and share.
user.invites.emptyBody: Make a link or QR code to pair {{name}}'s phone, tablet or browser.
user.signIn.passwordSet: Can sign in to the web player with a password, as well as on paired devices.
user.signIn.passwordNone: No password. Signs in only by pairing a device, which is simpler for most people.
user.signIn.recoveryBody: {{name}} saved a recovery code, so they can pair again without you. It can't be viewed, only revoked.
user.signIn.revokeBody: The code stops working at once. Their paired devices stay signed in.
user.password.description: They can then sign in to the web player with it. Paired devices stay signed in.
user.password.promoteDescription: Admins sign in to this console with a password. Choose one for them to use.
user.account.roleBody: Admins manage libraries, people and server settings, and see every book.
user.account.roleSelf: You can't change your own role. Another admin can.
user.danger.title: Danger zone
user.danger.disableBody: Their devices stop working until you enable the account again. Nothing is lost.
user.danger.disableSelf: You can't disable your own account here.
user.danger.enableBody: Their paired devices work again, with their progress where they left it.
user.danger.deleteBody: Permanently removes {{name}}'s progress, bookmarks, notes and history.
user.danger.deleteSelf: You can't delete your own account.
user.danger.deleteDescription: Removes the account and everything tied to it: devices, invites, progress, bookmarks, notes and history. Audio files are not touched. This can't be undone.
shares.title: Shares
shares.description: Named sets of folders you can give to people. A share follows its folders, so new books in them appear automatically.
shares.empty.title: No shares yet
shares.empty.body: Make a share for an author, a series or a few favourites, then give it to the people who should hear them.
shares.libraryGrantHint: Made when you give someone a whole library. Change who has it from each person's page.
shares.noFolders: No folders yet. Add one to fill the share.
shares.deleteBody_one: {{count}} person loses access to its books, unless another share covers them. No files are touched.
shares.deleteBody_other: {{count}} people lose access to its books, unless another share covers them. No files are touched.
shares.newDescription: Name it after what's in it. You add folders and people next.
shares.name: Name
shares.addFolderDescription: Pick a whole library, a folder, or a single book.
shares.pickerEmpty: Nothing to share in this folder.
shares.thisFolder: This folder and everything in it
settings.title: Settings
settings.description: How this server behaves. Changes apply at once.
settings.moreSoon: The other settings still live in config.yaml. They move here in a later update of this console.
settings.metadata.title: Community metadata
settings.metadata.description: Descriptions, series, characters and recaps from the community metadata service. Only a book's ASIN or ISBN is sent, never paths or who is listening.
settings.metadata.toggleBody: Players show the extra details only while this is on. Turning it off stops every outbound request.
settings.metadata.unavailableBody: Set metadata.base_url in config.yaml to an absolute http(s) address, then restart the server.
settings.metadata.offBody: No requests leave the server for it now.
libraries.unreadable.title: AudioSilo can't read this folder
libraries.unreadable.body: Check that {{root}} exists and that the server can read it, then retry. If it's a network share, mount it first.
